title: TelegramBridge
description: This project aims to establish a two-way connection with your server through your Telegram bot
body:
TelegramBridge is a lightweight and reliable tool designed to create a two-way connection between your server's in-game chat and your Telegram bot. Now you can monitor server activity and chat with players without even launching Minecraft.

✨ Key Features
Chat Broadcast: In-game messages are instantly delivered to Telegram.

Two-Way Communication: Send a message to the Telegram bot, and it will be visible to all players on the server.

Management: Set up administrators for remote control (depending on the version).

Lightweight: The plugin is highly optimized and won't put a strain on your system.

🛠️ How to Set Up (Step-by-Step Guide)
Download: Download the plugin version that matches your server core (1.21.4, etc.). Move the .jar file into your server's plugins folder.

First Launch: Start or restart your server to generate the TelegramBridge data folder.

Create a Bot: Message @BotFather on Telegram. Create a new bot and copy the provided API Token.

Get Your ID: Message @userinfobot to find your unique account ID. Copy it.

Configuration: Open plugins/TelegramBridge/config.yml with any text editor.

In the telegram-bot-token field, replace the text in quotes with your API Token.

In the whitelist and admin-ids fields, replace the text with your Account ID.

Finalize: Save the file and restart the server (or use the reload command, if available).
